title: CDK-X App
description: Scaffold a new cdkx app: an App/Stack entry point ready to synth.

directory.description: Directory to scaffold the app into, relative to the workspace root (e.g. "packages/my-app", "infra/my-infra", "cdkx"). Unlike the library/provider generators, this is not fixed to packages/<name>.
directory.x-prompt: Which directory should the app be scaffolded into?

name.description: Short kebab-case app name, used for the @cdk-x/<name> npm package and the example Stack's id. Defaults to the last path segment of directory.
